Items.Value: To ask His Majesty’s Government what plans they have to support family businesses in the UK.

Items.AttributedTo: Baroness in Waiting/Government Whip (Baroness Dacres of Lewisham) (Lab)
Items.Value: My Lords, this debate should take one hour. I remind your Lordships to keep to time, as that is very precious today.

My Lords, I must first declare that I am a member of a Somerset farming family, albeit now retired and living in Cornwall. I have also in my time started various small businesses, some of which failed but some did not.
